# Duplicate records triage, 2026-03-24

A week after go-live, technical services met to sort out the duplicate bibliographic records that the [[Project Kestrel|catalog migration]] left behind.

## What we found

- About 6,200 titles now show two records: one from our load and one already in the Lakes Consortium file. Patrons see both in search and place holds on the wrong one.
- Most duplicates are regional history titles, where our records carried local subject headings and the consortium copy did not.
- 140 item records attached to the wrong edition during matching.

## Next steps

[[Odile Varga]] will merge duplicates branch by branch, starting with Millbrook. Staff who find a suspect record should follow [[How to check a record after the cutover]] and report it rather than editing it.
